bar.title: Admin mode
bar.text: You're browsing communities as an admin: instead of reporting you can block, and blocked content is only visible to its owner.

notice.admin: Blocked: only its owner can see it.
notice.adminAppeal: The owner asked for a review.
notice.mine: The admins blocked your post, so people can't see it.
notice.note: Why should your post come back?
notice.pending: You asked for a review. The admins will decide soon.
notice.rejected: The admins reviewed your request and kept it blocked.

notifications.blocked: The admins blocked your post {{title}}. You can request a review
notifications.appealApproved: The admins reviewed your request and your post {{title}} is visible again
notifications.appealRejected: The admins reviewed your request and your post {{title}} stays blocked

admin.title: Review requests
admin.text: Owners of blocked posts ask for a review. Open the post and check it: if it breaks no rule bring it back, otherwise keep it blocked.
admin.empty: When someone's post is blocked and they ask for a review, it shows up here.
